sharedStateObservations.suggestion: Add note: code changes in optimization workers (graph mode, serving config) should be limited to external scripts and library documentation. sharedStateObservations.evidence: The combined-optimization-and-production commit included vLLM package style changes (mi100.py, pixtral.py, rocm.py, default_loader.py) that are unrelated to the combined optimization work. These are low-risk formatting changes, but mixing concerns in commits makes review harder.

summary: Feature is well-implemented. The combined optimization config (FULL_DECODE_ONLY graph mode + prefix caching) delivers meaningful throughput improvements: +16% synthetic at c2 (478 vs 412 tok/s), +245% coding agent at c2 (144 vs 42 tok/s), TPOT reduced 68-75%. Production launch script is well-documented with clear comments on excluded optimizations (MTP, TurboQuant) and expected performance. 200/200 sustained load test passed. All VAL-COMBO assertions fulfilled. The vLLM package code changes are purely cosmetic ruff formatting fixes that pass lint and typecheck.
